requirements.title: S10 two-lane ownership contract
requirements.acceptance: S10-MP and S10-RE boundaries, outputs and interface are explicit while external S10 identity remains unchanged.

requirements.title: Domain-specific operating depth
requirements.acceptance: Each targeted skill has method, decision rules, outputs, negative cases, recovery and tests.

requirements.title: Universal handoff envelope and semantic validator
requirements.acceptance: All skills can produce a schema-valid envelope; M00 validates references, ownership, hashes, dependencies and status semantics.

requirements.title: External trust root and human authority binding
requirements.acceptance: Project-controlled keys and role declarations cannot create trust; external identity/role/scope, revocation and quorum are verified.

requirements.title: Live prompt firewall and structural isolation
requirements.acceptance: Actual untrusted source text is scanned, quarantined where needed, isolated from tools and rescanned when changed.

requirements.title: Verifiable source provenance and claim support
requirements.acceptance: Source bytes/snapshot, hash, support locator, claim relation and qualified human review are independently traceable.

requirements.title: Single canonical control registry/evaluator
requirements.acceptance: One registry drives control identity and dispatch; legacy IDs map explicitly during migration.

requirements.title: Full registry/runtime parity
requirements.acceptance: All control metadata fields match the canonical registry and implementation.

requirements.title: Independent invalidation oracle
requirements.acceptance: Transitive closure is computed independently of project-supplied expected output and is property-tested.

requirements.title: Fail-closed resource ceiling
requirements.acceptance: Every applicable route has approved budget ceilings and evidence; missing required budgets block execution.

requirements.title: Explicit duration provenance and defaults
requirements.acceptance: Duration basis is explicit and frame arithmetic is reproducible; no implicit numeric default.

requirements.title: Identity and release compatibility
requirements.acceptance: No unapproved M00–S14 identity, path, trigger, state or API break.

requirements.title: Independent QA and output-level evidence
requirements.acceptance: Package, asset, renderer, actual media and human approval are separate QA levels.

execution.execution_scope: Local deterministic implementation and fixtures only; no external services or live production runtime.
